name: VideoLeap by Lightricks
summary: VideoLeap is a mobile video editing app with AI-powered effects, auto-cutting, and enhancement tools for quick, high-quality video creation.
description: VideoLeap is a mobile video editing app with AI-powered effects, auto-cutting, and enhancement tools for quick, high-quality video creation. Create standout videos with Videoleap, your intuitive video editor and video maker. Explore premade templates, advanced features, and AI tools. Start today. AI-powered effects: Instantly enhance footage and apply creative filters and transitions with a tap. Auto-cut and montage: Automatically find and assemble the best clips for polished, professional videos. Layered editing: Combine video clips, images, and soundtracks with advanced compositing tools. Mobile-first: Edit and publish on the go with full-featured apps for iOS and Android devices.

howToUse.title: Download VideoLeap App
howToUse.description: Download and install VideoLeap from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android). Launch the app on your mobile device.

howToUse.title: Start a New Project
howToUse.description: Tap the '+' button to create a new project. Import your video clips, photos, or audio from your device.

howToUse.title: Edit with AI Tools
howToUse.description: Use AI-powered effects, auto-cut, and montage tools to enhance and assemble your video. Apply filters, transitions, and creative overlays.

howToUse.title: Arrange Clips and Layers
howToUse.description: Drag and drop video clips, images, and soundtracks onto the timeline. Use advanced layering and compositing options as needed.

howToUse.title: Preview and Adjust
howToUse.description: Preview your edit in real time. Trim, split, or reorder clips, and adjust colors, speed, or effects.

howToUse.title: Export and Share
howToUse.description: Export your finished video in high resolution. Share directly to social media or save to your device.

features_fr: Effets basés sur l'IA : améliorez instantanément les séquences et appliquez des filtres et des transitions créatifs d'un simple toucher.
Découpe et montage automatiques : recherchez et assemblez automatiquement les meilleurs clips pour des vidéos soignées et professionnelles.
Édition en couches : combinez des clips vidéo, des images et des bandes sonores avec des outils de composition avancés.
Le mobile d'abord : modifiez et publiez en déplacement avec des applications complètes pour les appareils iOS et Android.
